narrative: A black-letter bill on the table. Title, house, and hour. No author's name. No face. The lower line names the company. His name is not on the paper. The bill stays flat. The bill where it was laid. The hat is not taken up. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill and did not leave the house.

entities.name: the Shrew
entities.context: Shown on bill in The Shrew, and he is not in it
